proof_body:
by
  intro F f S c x hu hc hS hx
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu (ε / 2) (half_pos hε))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.1 hc (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hx δ hδ
  refine ⟨max K1 K2, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have a := hK1 n (le_of_max_le_left hn) (x n) (hS n)
  have b := h (hS n) (hK2 n (le_of_max_le_right hn))
  exact (dist_triangle_left _ _ (f (x n))).trans_lt (by linarith)
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ), TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S → ContinuousWithinAt f S c → (∀ n, x n ∈ S) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds c) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F n (x n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (f c))
